:::{#def-strict-inequality}
#### Strict inequalities

For [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $a$ and $b$,
$a < b$ ("$a$ is less than $b$")
and $a > b$ ("$a$ is greater than $b$")
are **strict inequalities**
[@wikipedia_inequality_mathematics].

:::
